options.content:
## REIMS2 statistics & monitoring

Includes the following categories:
1. Lens Bank Stats: Shows statistics on dispensed glasses within the selected time range
2. Current inventory
3. Additions/Deletions: Statistics on glasses that have been added, as well as deleted or dispensed in the selected time range

Tips:
- Select a time range at the top right
- Select the location at the top left

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'in_stock'
AND location LIKE $location

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(dispense_date, '1d') as time,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'dispensed'
  AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)
  AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'dispensed'
AND location LIKE $location
AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, creation_date, dispense_date)) as year
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'dispensed'
AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)
AND location LIKE $location

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(dispense_date, '1h') as time,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'dispensed'
  AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)
  AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, creation_date, CURDATE())) as year
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'in_stock'
AND location LIKE $location

SELECT ${glasses_attrs:csv}, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'dispensed'
AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY ${glasses_attrs:csv}

panels.description: independent of selected time, MINUS/PLUS based on OD

targets.rawSql:
SELECT glasses_type, COUNT(*) as Count, (CASE WHEN od_sphere < 0 THEN 'Minus' ELSE 'Plus' END) as positive
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'in_stock'
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY glasses_type, positive

panels.title: Category with MINUS/PLUS

panels.description: time range does not apply here

targets.rawSql:
SELECT od_add as Additional, (COUNT(*) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as float) * 100) as percentage, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'in_stock'
AND location LIKE $location
AND glasses_type LIKE 'multifocal'
GROUP BY od_add
ORDER BY od_add

panels.title: Multifocal ADD distribution for current inventory (OD only)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ${glasses_attrs:csv}, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'in_stock'
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY ${glasses_attrs:csv}

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(creation_date, '1d') as time,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_date)
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(dispense_date, '1d') as time,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  dispense_reason as reason
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'removed'
AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY time, reason
ORDER BY time, reason

SELECT
  dispense_reason as reason,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE status = 'removed'
AND $__timeFilter(dispense_date)
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY reason

SELECT ${glasses_attrs:csv}, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_glasses
WHERE $__timeFilter(creation_date)
AND location LIKE $location
GROUP BY ${glasses_attrs:csv}

SELECT COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_unsuccessful_search
WHERE location LIKE $location
  AND $__timeFilter(search_date)

SELECT od_add as Additional, (COUNT(*) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as float) * 100) as percentage, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_unsuccessful_search
WHERE location LIKE $location
  AND glasses_type LIKE 'multifocal'
  AND $__timeFilter(search_date)
GROUP BY od_add
ORDER BY od_add

panels.title: Multifocal ADD distribution of unsuccessful searches

panels.description: independent of selected time, MINUS/PLUS based on OD

targets.rawSql:
SELECT glasses_type, COUNT(*) as Count, (CASE WHEN od_sphere < 0 THEN 'Minus' ELSE 'Plus' END) as positive
FROM stats_unsuccessful_search
WHERE location LIKE $location
  AND $__timeFilter(search_date)
GROUP BY glasses_type, positive

panels.title: Unsuccessful searches category

targets.rawSql:
SELECT FLOOR(od_sphere) as Sphere, (COUNT(*) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as float) * 100) as percentage, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM stats_unsuccessful_search
WHERE location LIKE $location
AND glasses_type LIKE $glasses_type
AND $__timeFilter(search_date)
GROUP BY Sphere
ORDER BY Sphere
